channel.title: Qiushui Youxin · 秋水有信
channel.description: Notes, letters and fragments by Yingqiu — life, old writings, music, reading, and the long road of learning.

item.title: Overview · What this course covers and how to read it
item.description: Where the 32 lessons come from, how they were edited, the arc of the course, and the rules that run through every session.

item.title: Lesson 01 · Consolidation and Trade Selection After a Trend Ends
item.description: Why a finished trend always turns into a range, why trading inside the box has no edge, and the three conditions of a good trade.

item.title: Lesson 02 · Reading a Range and How to Review Charts
item.description: How a trading box forms and matures, where a short inside it has any edge, and a step-by-step method for daily chart review.

item.title: Lesson 03 · Breakout Entries and the Cost of Counter-trend Trades
item.description: A trade-by-trade review of one week: big versus small corrections inside an uptrend, why counter-trend shorts fail, and why position splitting saved the curve.

item.title: Lesson 04 · Psychology Under Drawdown and the Long Thesis
item.description: A week of TRB, SOL, GST, LINK and ARK trades reviewed: why counter-trend entries fail, how oversizing kills stops, and where a leader uptrend is entered.

item.title: Lesson 05 · Breakout Entries and Stop Execution
item.description: A week of breakout trades on TRB, LINK, ETH, ORDI and BNT, why high-level breakouts fail, and a three-month roadmap for BTC and ETH.

item.title: Lesson 06 · Entry Points and Emotional Control
item.description: A trade-by-trade review of a losing week: entries made too high, stops placed wrong, counter-trend tilt, and why catching every leader still made no money.

item.title: Lesson 07 · Large-Scale Breakouts and Trading Psychology
item.description: Why a breakout that chases must be sized light, how repeated small-stop attempts win when the big picture is right, and the altcoin watchlist with targets.

item.title: Lesson 08 · Reading Trends and Opportunities in a Correction
item.description: Why BTC near 42,000 gets hard to trade, why alts lack independent moves, and how the USTC and BIGTIME runs show which positions in a leader are worth taking.

item.title: Lesson 09 · Catch-up Rallies and Exit Signals at the End of a Move
item.description: How leaders like ORDI and BIGTIME move in step with BTC, when capital retreats, and how to trade divergences in a main uptrend.

item.title: Lesson 10 · Executing Stops and Trading Psychology
item.description: Where a stop belongs, three signs of a stable edge, why understanding a chart is not the same as trading it, and an ORDI long reviewed.

item.title: Lesson 11 · What Leaders Have in Common During Rotation
item.description: BTC at the top of its box, why ETH must hold 2100, and why a market that changes its leader every day is a trap worth cutting exposure for.

item.title: Lesson 12 · Counter-trend Risk and the Stop-Loss Mindset
item.description: A review of a losing week in WLD, INJ and ACE: why counter-trend shorts have no solution, why every trade carries a stop, and why size must come down.

item.title: Lesson 13 · Being Bullish Is Not the Same as Buying
item.description: Why BTC at a high is bullish but not a buy, the ETH breakout signal to wait for, leverage limits, and why news never changes a trend.

item.title: Lesson 14 · Choose Markets That Follow Rules
item.description: A weekly trade review: why manipulated coins are untouchable, breakout entries on TRB and ICP, and exit discipline on ORDI at the top.

item.title: Lesson 16 · Patience and Rhythm in a Range
item.description: BTC is in the tail end of a rebound: stay long-biased but trade short, ignore news, and watch for ETH to lead the next leg.

item.title: Lesson 17 · Space and Breakout Logic in Trend Trading
item.description: Two altcoin breakout longs and two counter-trend shorts show the three conditions for a trend trade and why shorts are so hard to hold.

item.title: Lesson 18 · The Scale and Cycle of a Correction
item.description: How to size the correction after a two-month BTC rally, why a counter-trend short can be held, and what each direction out of the range means.

item.title: Lesson 19 · Reading Counter-trend Trades from the Market Environment
item.description: A review of last week’s TIA and BTC shorts and four longs, showing why identical setups diverge and how to handle counter-trend trades.

item.title: Lesson 20 · Trading Logic Inside the Market Environment
item.description: Reviewing the BTC second wave and the TIA, ZETA, ORDI, LPT and ICP trades, separating resonance plays from independent sector moves.

item.title: Lesson 21 · Choosing Between Resonance and Catch-up Trades
item.description: A review of the week BTC ran to 65000: why PEPE was the trade, why DOGE, LTC and SOL catch-ups felt bad, and the two setups to wait for.

item.title: Lesson 23 · Market Cycles and Short-term Opportunities
item.description: Why a winter market can still carry one or two coins, a seven-trade walk through PEPE on the five-minute chart, and a frank review of my own mistakes on it.

item.title: Lesson 24 · Pacing a Correction and Spotting the Leader
item.description: Why BTC is not correcting the usual 20 percent, how to stay aggressive in a hot market, and why leaders that rally with BTC matter.

item.title: Lesson 25 · Following Market Mood and Building a System
item.description: A missed perfect rebound entry, why a light left-side base position makes sense in a bull mood, and how drawdowns build a trading system.

item.title: Lesson 26 · Reviewing Losses and Regaining Discipline
item.description: A trade-by-trade review of a losing week on ETHFI, PEPE, BCH and SUI, separating system losses from FOMO mistakes.

item.title: Lesson 27 · Market Stages and Position Management
item.description: The full trading framework: seasonal market cycles, the six logical entry points in the life of a coin, and why sizing decides your psychology.

item.title: Lesson 28 · Breakouts and Stop Losses Inside a Range
item.description: Two trades from a BTC high-level range: a short on the downside break and a long on the false breakout, with entry timing and stops.

item.title: Lesson 29 · Entries and Exits in Main Uptrends and Ranges
item.description: CEL and TRB as case studies: read the BTC cycle first, mark resistance, then trade breakouts, pullbacks and divergence waves.

item.title: Lesson 30 · Counter-trend Shorts and Scaling Out
item.description: A PEPE breakout long, a BTC trendline trade exited in three parts, and two failed PEPE shorts explain why ranges demand modest expectations.

item.title: Lesson 31 · Spotting the Leader and the Second Wave
item.description: After the ETH surge, how PEOPLE was chosen, why the breakout was taken early, and why the next move belongs to the leader.

item.title: Lesson 32 · Leader Continuation Versus Catch-up Trades
item.description: Reading the second wave in PEOPLE, two likely setups for the week, why catch-up trades are a fallback, and sizing when chasing.

item.title: 总览 · 这门课讲了什么，怎么读
item.description: 32 场直播课的整理说明：材料来源、整理原则、课程脉络，以及贯穿全课的几条核心规则。

item.title: 第01课 · 趋势结束后的震荡与交易选择
item.description: 趋势走完必须震荡，箱体内部没有确定性；一笔好交易靠的是建立在情绪周期划分上的开仓逻辑、小止损和平稳的持仓心态。

item.title: 第02课 · 箱体震荡的区间判断与复盘方法
item.description: 一个箱体怎样从初期走到末期，为什么箱体内部没有确定性、只在边缘收敛处出手，以及每天带着问题一根一根翻 K 线的复盘方法。

item.title: 第03课 · 突破进场与逆势交易的得失
item.description: 大分歧与小分歧的做法为什么不同，顺势单只有一个启动位置而逆势单要试很多遍，亏损为什么全来自逻辑不清的上头单，分仓怎样提供容错。

item.title: 第04课 · 浮盈回撤中的心态与多头逻辑
item.description: 上头的几种表现：逆势单、重仓毁掉有效止损、假突破时出掉有成本优势的底仓；以及一段标准龙头主升浪该在哪介入、止损放哪。

item.title: 第05课 · 突破进场与止损执行
item.description: 一周突破单的亏损几乎都出在同一个地方：做在高位突破位而不是启动位。拆解多单和空单各自该开在哪，以及高位重仓加流动性差的币会怎样把底仓一起丢掉。

item.title: 第06课 · 进场点位与心态控制
item.description: 一周亏损单的共同病根是一个没意识到的转变：从回踩企稳位进场变成了高位打突破。拆解一笔单子要回答的两个问题、有效止损只有一个位置，以及龙头全抓到却没赚钱的原因。

item.title: 第07课 · 大级别突破与交易心态
item.description: 大级别结构够了的突破可以追，但追单的止损只能放在启动附近，所以仓位必须轻。再讲方向对了就在小级别反复试错，以及抓大放小的进场原则和这一轮山寨的做法。

item.title: 第08课 · 调整阶段的趋势与机会判断
item.description: 用 USTC 和 BIGTIME 两只龙头拆一轮主升浪里能做的位置：关键压力位的突破尝试、大分歧后的二次探底、突破后拿到加速，以及五浪走完后为什么都是垃圾行情。

item.title: 第09课 · 行情末期的补涨与撤退信号
item.description: 龙头和大饼共振的三步节奏：大饼盘整末期启动、波段顶部撤退、之后只剩补涨余热。错过启动只做分歧承接，高位不追多也不摸空。

item.title: 第10课 · 止损执行与交易心态
item.description: 止损放在市场的关键点位，碰到就代表方向短期不成立；看得懂的行情不等于好做的行情，只做有确定性的顺势点位。附一笔 ORDI 多单的案例。

item.title: 第11课 · 市场轮动中的龙头共性
item.description: 龙头有共识才好做：ORDI 见顶后市场每天换龙头，只有拉起来才知道谁是龙头，表面的赚钱效应是陷阱。大饼箱体高位不好赚钱，这种行情该降仓防守。

item.title: 第12课 · 逆势单的风险与止损心态
item.description: 一周亏四万 U 的原因只有三个：仓位大、止损小、做逆势。用 WLD、INJ、ACE 三组单子讲逆势单为什么无解、箱体内部为什么没有确定性、好单子为什么也要带止损。

item.title: 第13课 · 看多与做多的区别
item.description: 大饼高位获利盘未消化，看多不等于做多，调整前只做短线；以太率先突破才是积极做多的信号。附杠杆上限、买定离手和消息不改变趋势三条原则。

item.title: 第14课 · 选择有规律的行情
item.description: 控盘的币没有规律不碰；有规律的行情里，开仓位置决定止损大小和单子拿不拿得住；龙头到了高位只能边拉边跑。以ACE、TRB、ICP、以太、ORDI为例。

item.title: 第16课 · 震荡期的耐心与操作节奏
item.description: 大饼从18000起的反弹已到鱼尾，看多但只做短；调整只有用空间或用时间两种消化方式；消息只是刺激，以太独立走强才是下一轮大行情的信号。

item.title: 第17课 · 顺势交易的空间与突破逻辑
item.description: 顺势做突破要同时满足空间、顺势、箱体三条，拿多久由市场氛围决定；逆势单做对了也难拿，一旦加速必须减仓。附什么叫突破、龙头的特征。

item.title: 第18课 · 行情调整的级别与周期
item.description: 两个月的上涨结束后，调整的级别怎么定，为什么这时逆势空单可以拿而新单不能开，调整完向上、向下两种剧本各意味着什么。

item.title: 第19课 · 从市场环境识别逆势单
item.description: 上周六笔单子只有两类，同样的结构有环境支撑和没有环境结果两极；逆势单为什么天然难拿，没开在启动点又该怎么介入。

item.title: 第20课 · 市场环境中的交易逻辑
item.description: 春节前后大饼二波里的 TIA、ORDI、ZETA、LPT 四笔多单分成两类：跟大饼共振的和独立板块的，介入节点和看法各不相同，而市场环境排在所有技术之前。

item.title: 第21课 · 共振与补涨的机会选择
item.description: 大饼冲到六万五这一周，机会分大饼、共振龙头、补涨三层：PEPE 为什么是龙头，LTC、SOL、狗狗币的补涨为什么不流畅，怎样用春夏秋冬判断阶段。

item.title: 第23课 · 市场周期与短线机会
item.description: 同样是砸完之后的冬天，为什么这次还能做 WLD；再用 PEPE 五分钟图拆一遍龙头主升浪里顺势的七笔短线，以及底仓下车后为什么必须做回来。

item.title: 第24课 · 调整期的节奏与龙头机会
item.description: 上涨途中反复插针的大饼为什么调不深，牛市氛围下调整期该用多激进的节奏参与，以及为什么跟大饼共振起来的龙头比任何结构都更有确定性。

item.title: 第25课 · 顺应市场情绪与建立交易体系
item.description: 调整周期里的反弹为什么只能等右侧信号，62000 那个下降趋势终结的拐点好在哪，以及只跟市场情绪做趋势、靠复盘和回撤建立体系的方法。

item.title: 第26课 · 复盘亏损与找回交易纪律
item.description: 把一周里 ETHFI、PEPE、BCH、SUI 的亏损单逐笔拆开，分清体系内的正常磨损和怕踏空导致的无逻辑单，再讲为什么止损和仓位是唯一的保命线。

item.title: 第27课 · 行情阶段的划分与仓位管理
item.description: 交易体系的三个维度：市场周期决定该不该做，一个币从生到死的六个点位决定在哪做，分仓低杠杆决定拿不拿得住；用亏掉的四十万刀做反例。

item.title: 第28课 · 箱体震荡中的突破与止损
item.description: 高位箱体里只有两个位置有逻辑：上沿下来的第一次反弹和盘整好之后的突破。用一笔短空和一笔假突破多单讲突破为什么不追、止损止盈放哪。

item.title: 第29课 · 主升浪与箱体中的进出场逻辑
item.description: 山寨能不能做先看大饼周期，再划压力位。用 CEL 讲主升浪里小分歧只承接不突破、大分歧后等二波，用 TRB 讲箱体结构的币只能等突破。

item.title: 第30课 · 逆势短空与分批止盈
item.description: 箱体内部的单子不是主升，预期要小、止盈要分批；箱体顶没有做空逻辑，没有高位五浪和假突破就只能短空。用大饼趋势线单和 PEPE 两笔单子说明。

item.title: 第31课 · 龙头识别与第二波机会
item.description: 以太暴拉之后第一反应是找山寨龙头：选前面有过异动的币，情绪明牌时敢在前高前打突破，龙头看谁最流畅，后面的机会在龙头二波。

item.title: 第32课 · 龙头延续与补涨机会的取舍
item.description: 龙头突破回踩后当主升浪刚启动看，只盯最强的两只；补涨永远是错过龙头之后的退路；追高就降仓位、放合理止损，不反复挨小止损。
